meta.name: summarize-meeting
meta.description: Summarize a meeting transcript into structured notes with date, participants, topic, key decisions, summary points, and action items. Use when processing meeting recordings, creating meeting notes, writing meeting minutes, or recapping discussions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把会议录音转成结构化笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理会议纪要
copy.tagline_en: Turn meeting recordings into structured notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to organize meeting minutes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据会议记录或录音，自动生成结构化的会议纪要，包含日期、参与者、主题、关键决策、总结要点和待办事项。
howto.when: 当你提供会议记录、录音或笔记，或要求整理会议纪要时触发。

say.text: 帮我总结这段会议录音，列出待办事项。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键信息并生成结构化摘要。

say.text: 根据这份会议笔记，生成一份包含决策和行动项的纪要。
say.note: Claude 会按模板输出完整纪要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate structured meeting summaries from transcripts or recordings, including date, participants, topic, key decisions, summary points, and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a meeting transcript, recording, or notes, or ask to create meeting minutes.

say_en.text: Summarize this meeting recording and list action items.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key info and creates a structured summary.

say_en.text: From these meeting notes, generate a summary with decisions and action items.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a complete summary using the template.
